page: Server-side WebSocket support in Hono applications. Adapters: Cloudflare Workers/Pages, Deno, Bun, Node.js. Main function: upgradeWebSocket(). Handlers with events: onOpen (Cloudflare not supported), onMessage, onClose, onError. Handler receives context and WebSocket object. RPC mode support via hc<> client. Configuration: Bun exports { fetch, websocket }. Node.js uses @hono/node-server with ws package and WebSocketServer({ noServer: true }). Deprecated: @hono/node-ws. Caveat: middleware modifying headers can conflict with upgradeWebSocket() causing immutable header errors. Questions: How do I set up WebSocket handlers in Hono? What are the available WebSocket events? How do I use RPC mode with WebSockets? Which runtimes are supported? How do I implement WebSocket in Node.js? What's the difference between platform implementations?

sections.manifest: Import statements by runtime. Cloudflare Workers: hono/cloudflare-workers. Deno: hono/deno. Bun: hono/bun exports upgradeWebSocket and websocket. Node.js: @hono/node-server with upgradeWebSocket, requires ws package and @types/ws for TypeScript. Configuration for Node.js: create WebSocketServer with { noServer: true } option, pass via serve() websocket parameter. Deprecated package: @hono/node-ws. Questions: Which import do I use for each runtime? What dependencies are needed for Node.js? Why is @hono/node-ws deprecated?

upgradeWebSocket() returns handler for WebSocket connections. Receives context parameter. Returns object with event handlers: onOpen (not supported Cloudflare Workers), onMessage(event, ws), onClose(), onError(). Handler can log messages, send responses via ws.send(). Available events documented. Caveat: middleware that modifies headers conflicts with upgradeWebSocket() causing immutable header errors. Guidance: be cautious using WebSocket Helper with header-modifying middleware like CORS. Questions: What are the WebSocket event handlers? How do I send messages to clients? Why does middleware cause errors? What parameters do handlers receive?

RPC mode enables type-safe WebSocket communication. Export typeof wsApp as WebSocketApp type from server. Client uses hc<WebSocketApp>() to create typed client. Client accesses WebSocket via .$ws() method. Type inference works with RPC pattern. Questions: How do I implement RPC mode WebSockets? How do I create a typed client for WebSockets? What type should I export from server?

Three implementation examples provided. Server-client example: server.ts with onMessage handler, client.ts with hc<> and $ws() accessing WebSocket. Bun with JSX example: Hono app serves HTML with inline script, WebSocket at /ws, server sends timestamp via ws.send() in setInterval from onOpen, onClose clears interval, client receives via ws.onmessage. Node.js example: upgradeWebSocket with onMessage echoing data, WebSocketServer with { noServer: true }, serve() with { websocket: { server: wss } } option. Questions: How do I create a real-time chat app? How do I send periodic updates to clients? How do I handle connection lifecycle?
